messageNotification.channels.guidance.ge: Enter the settings required by this provider, then save to use it in supported notification flows.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.em: Send email through an SMTP server. Configure recipients and content in message templates.
Enable SMTP in the sender account settings. Use an authorization code or app password when required.
A preset fills the connection settings. Check the port and encryption against your provider requirements. Additional SMTP options are available under extended properties.
Use credentials for the same mailbox. A blank sender defaults to the username. After saving, select a compatible template for a test.
Check that SMTP is enabled and the account, authorization code or app password is correct.
Check the server, port, encryption and network connectivity from the platform.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.di: Send work notifications through a DingTalk application. Set the application ID and recipients in message templates.
Create or select an internal application in DingTalk and include notification recipients in its visibility scope.
Copy the AppKey and AppSecret from the same application.
Configure the application permissions and server access restrictions required by DingTalk. Set AgentId, recipients and content in the template.
Check application credentials, permissions and the provider IP settings.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.ro: Send notifications to a DingTalk group using its robot Webhook.
Add a robot to the target group and configure security supported by the current provider.
Copy the full robot Webhook URL. It contains credentials and is protected after saving. Configure message content in the template.
Check the full URL, robot availability and whether its security policy permits the message.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.we: Send work notifications through a WeCom application. Set the application ID and recipients in message templates.
Select an application in the WeCom admin console and verify that recipients are in its visibility scope.
Enter the enterprise ID and the corresponding application Secret. Do not mix credentials from different applications.
Configure access restrictions required by WeCom. AgentId, recipients and content are specified in the template.
Check the enterprise ID, application Secret and access restrictions for the intended application.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.sm: Send notifications through an SMS provider. Configure the signature, template code and recipients in message templates.
Enable SMS with the selected provider and verify sending permissions.
Enter the AccessKey ID, AccessKey Secret and required region. Use an account with only the required permissions.
Have the provider approve your signature and template, then enter them with recipient parameters in message templates.
Check that the signature and template code belong to the account associated with these credentials.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.vo: Send voice notifications through a voice provider. Configure phone numbers and template parameters in message templates.
Enable voice notifications with the selected provider and verify API permissions.
Enter the AccessKey ID, AccessKey Secret and required region for the same account.
Prepare numbers and voice templates as required by the provider, then configure call parameters in message templates.
Check the credentials, voice service permissions and region.
messageNotification.channels.guidance.we: Send notifications to an HTTP service. Configure request content in message templates.
Enter the HTTP or HTTPS URL supplied by the target system and verify that the platform can reach it.
Enter headers required by the receiver. Header values are protected; a blank input retains a readable saved value only.
Check the URL, network connectivity and authentication headers.
